M6-019.title: The STMG state-manager reader (0x9B0B14): the threshold, max voices, the two group tables and the 37-parameter table
evidence: R1/R2 threshold: f32 0x9B0B28..0x9B0B48 -> setter 0x9A080C(type 2); u16 max voices 0x9B0B64..0x9B0B88 -> 0x9A0EA4
R3/R3d state groups: count 0x9B0BA0..0x9B0B/0x9B0D40; entry {u32 id, u32 field2, u32 n, n x {u32,u32,u32}}; n=0 in every shipped group

R4/R4e switch groups: count 0x9B0D50..0x9B0D8C; entry {u32 id, u32, u8 flags, u32 n, n x 12-byte bulk}; the flags field is a 1-byte read (0x9B0DCC mov r2,r0 -> 0x9B0DD8; consumed 0x9B1474 ldrb); items strided 12 (0xA3274C)

R5/R5g parameters: count 0x9B0E7C..0x9B0FAC; entry {u32 id, f32 value -> entry+8 (0xA0F594), u32 ramp type, f32 up, f32 down, u8 built-in (1-byte, 0x9B0F70 mov r2,sl -> 0x9B0F7C)} 21 bytes; ramp via 0xA0F5AC
shipped Init.bnk STMG body 1095 bytes: offsets 0/4/6/82/306; event_volume 0xD2687048 index 30 = 1.0, robot_volume 0x637C1240 index 12 = 1.0

M6-020.title: STMG: the group-item field meanings and the two trailing bodies (unread source; unexercised by shipped banks)
evidence: R6 trailing count A 0x9B0FBC..0x9B0FE8: a non-zero count reads a 56-byte body per entry (1 x u32, 6 x u16, 10 x u32; 0x9B1038/0x9B1060/0x9B10E8) and calls 0xA3B84C; A=0 in every shipped bank
R7 trailing count B 0x9B12A4..0x9B12C8: a non-zero count reads a 40-byte body per entry (10 x u32; 0x9B1430/0x9B12E0) and calls 0xA3BA44; B=0 in every shipped bank
state-group item handler 0xA27CA4 (stores f2 at element+8, stride 0xC); switch-group item handler 0xA325E0 (f0 at +0, float(index) at +4, f2 at +8, f1 into an id array)
the Wwise field names of the item triples and the two trailing bodies are not in the binary
